summary: ```markdown # CLO Master Express Course Lesson 18: Custom Hairstyles & Shoe Live Stream **Subtitles brought to you by the Figaro Cuisine Squad** --- ## Introduction Hello everyone, good evening! Today, I'm live streaming with Samantha. I don't know if you guys still remember, but I did a live stream of XiaoNiu before. Today, I'll bring you a self-designed live stream. The main focus of this session is how to create custom hairstyles, shoes, and also a self-designed zipper and buckle. --- ## Custom Hairstyles ### Opening the Virtual Model First of all, let's talk about how to make self-designed hair. To create custom hair, we first need to open our virtual model in CLO. If you want to design a male model, then open the male model; if you want to design a female model, then open the female model. After opening it, we need to remove the hair and shoes from the model entirely. ### Creating the Hair Once the model is prepared, we'll proceed to create the hair. 1. **Remove Existing Hair:** Make sure to completely remove the current hair and shoes. 2. **Design Hair:** Based on this virtual model, we will create the hair. 3. **Check Model Compatibility:** Ensure that the model's foot posture is adjusted accordingly for the shoe design. ### Exporting the Hair 1. Go to the file menu and select "Export." 2. Choose the FBX format and specify the file path. 3. Make sure the username is in English and uses underscores, without any Chinese characters. 4. Save the flat shoe FBX file, making sure to include the virtual model in the export. ### Adjusting for High Heels 1. Right-click on the model to adjust the heel for high heels. 2. Follow the same export process as for the flat shoe, ensuring to include the virtual model. --- ## Creating Shoes ### Using 3D Software Next, we will use other 3D software to add hair and shoes. You can use 3D Max, Maya, C4D, etc. I prefer using Blender, so I will explain using Blender. ### Setting Units in Blender 1. **Change Units:** Change the unit in Blender from meters to millimeters to avoid compatibility issues. 2. **Importing the Model:** Select "File" > "Import" > "FBX," and import the virtual model. 3. **Designing Hair and Shoes:** Now, you can add the hair and shoes to the model. ### Modifying the Hair 1. **Add Hair Model:** Import the hair model into Blender. 2. **Adjust Grid Orientation:** Ensure that all grid directions face outward. 3. **Check Hair Model:** Adjust the hair model for aesthetics and functionality. ### Finalizing the Hair Model 1. **Add Downy Mesh:** To prevent clipping with the hair, add a protective "downy mesh." 2. **Material Settings:** Adjust the material settings to ensure that the downy mesh remains invisible in CLO. --- ## Customizing Zippers and Buckles ### Preparing the Zipper Model 1. **Import Zipper Model:** Open the pre-made zipper file in Blender. 2. **Adjust Position:** Place the zipper vertically on the Z-axis and ensure it aligns properly with the model. 3. **Export Zipper:** Export as OBJ, naming it appropriately for use in CLO. ### Creating the Puller 1. **Positioning the Puller:** The puller should sit correctly on the model. 2. **Export Puller:** Similar to the zipper, export the puller as OBJ. --- ## Custom Buttons ### Setting Up Custom Buttons 1. **Creating Buttons:** Set up custom buttons with different sizes and export them as OBJ. 2. **Adjusting Button Properties:** You can add multiple sizes to the same button type for versatility. --- ## Conclusion This live stream covered a variety of topics related to custom hairstyles, shoes, zippers, and buttons in CLO. If you have any questions, feel free to ask in the comments. Thank you for watching! I will end this live stream in the next 5 minutes. If you have any specific topics you'd like to see covered in future streams, please let me know! --- **End of Transcript** ```
